lifecycle.register: RegistrationContext => void; synchronous; once per activation
lifecycle.stop: ModuleContext => void | Promise<void>; once even after start fails

register.replace: one candidate automatically; multiple candidates require a table preference before mounting

context.root: owned HTMLElement; native content restored after failed replacement
context.scope: one module, one table, one mounting UUID
context.cleanup: AbortSignal first; cleanup in reverse order; every cleanup attempted; asynchronous cleanup deadline 5000 ms

assets.paths: relative to signed installed package; no traversal, URL or query

styles.isolation: namespaced CSS by convention; no Shadow DOM; no sandbox

storage.local: browser/module namespace; JSON; 256 KiB per value
storage.table: module/table; participant reads; GM writes; persistent JSON CAS
storage.revision: opaque string; expectedRevision null creates; matching revision updates or deletes

events.delivery: authorized table audience only; scene events filtered by mount scene

coordinates.viewport: scene.overlay only; CSS pixels, independent of device pixel ratio

versioning.rollback: code version only; persisted data is never reverted

binary.input: Blob in JS; multipart metadata JSON + file part; server builds file metadata
binary.output: DownloadedFile in JS; authenticated attachment response
binary.abort: CallOptions.signal; before committed write cancellation prevents work; committed changes are not undone
binary.progress: optional callback; Fetch transport reports completion
